ms-d9cadeaa-c5ea-4436-8e49-6ec8d25e8a3c.headline: Internal support dashboard with real SSO and deploy stubs, blocked by a paid chart licence and unfinished launch setup.
ms-d9cadeaa-c5ea-4436-8e49-6ec8d25e8a3c.summary: Ops Dashboard is an internal React web app for support staff to view tickets and on-call status via Okta login, hosted on the office Kubernetes cluster. It has the right private scope and basic Docker and cluster files, but they are stubs. It cannot ship until the paid Highcharts licence is sorted and deployment, SSO config, and data handling are finished.

audience.detail: README says internal dashboard for the support team with company SSO (Okta) on the office cluster.

mobile.detail: No mobile or desktop signals; code is a React web dashboard served as static files.

deployment.detail: Dockerfile, Kubernetes file, and CI file exist but all look like empty stubs with no image, ingress, secrets, or build jobs.

license.detail: package.json says UNLICENSED private true but the LICENSE file is empty, so reuse rules are unclear.

ms-d9cadeaa-c5ea-4436-8e49-6ec8d25e8a3c.data_detail: Shows open support tickets and on-call info plus staff SSO login, so it handles customer and staff personal data.

assets.name: react 18.3.1
assets.note: Free front-end library for this dashboard use.

assets.name: @okta/okta-react 6.9.0
assets.note: Login library matching the described Okta SSO.

assets.name: chart.js 4.4.3
assets.note: Free chart library for dashboard graphs.

assets.name: highcharts 11.4.0
assets.note: Paid chart library that needs a bought licence.

issues.title: Paid Highcharts used with no licence proof
issues.explain: Highcharts is a paid product, not free like React or Chart.js. No licence proof or CREDITS file was found, so use could trigger a bill or takedown.
issues.recommendation: Buy a Highcharts licence or replace it with Chart.js which is already included.
issues.ai_prompt: In package.json and src/App.jsx, remove the 'highcharts' dependency and all 'import Highcharts' usage and rewrite those charts using only chart.js 4.4.3. Show me the diff and confirm no highcharts import remains.

issues.title: Kubernetes file is incomplete stub
issues.explain: The Kubernetes file only sets replicas with no image, port, secrets, or network rules. It cannot safely run as-is.
issues.recommendation: Complete the deployment with image, resource limits, Okta secrets via Kubernetes Secrets, and internal-only ingress with HTTPS.
issues.ai_prompt: Fill in deploy/k8s-deployment.yaml for ops-dashboard with image, 2 replicas, containerPort, envFrom secret okta-credentials, ClusterIP service, and an internal-only Ingress with TLS. Do not paste secret values, only secret references.

issues.title: Dockerfile not production ready
issues.explain: Dockerfile copies everything, runs as root, and serves without HTTPS or health checks. Okta keys could leak if baked in.
issues.evidence: Dockerfile: COPY . /app + RUN cd /app && npm ci && npm run build + CMD ["npx","serve","/app/dist"]
issues.recommendation: Use multi-stage build, non-root user, .dockerignore, and pass Okta settings at run time, not in the image.
issues.ai_prompt: Rewrite Dockerfile to use node:20-alpine as build, copy package files first, run npm ci and build, then use a non-root nginx or serve runtime, expose port, add USER node, HEALTHCHECK, and no secrets in the image.

issues.title: SSO protection not proven complete
issues.explain: SSO wrapper is there but the auth config and login checks are not shown. If misconfigured the internal ticket data could be open to the internet.
issues.recommendation: Verify Okta issuer and client ID come from secrets, force login on all pages, and restrict network to VPN/intranet.
issues.ai_prompt: In src/App.jsx show the full Okta Security config with issuer, clientId from env vars, redirect URI, and LoginCallback route, and ensure all routes require login with no public access.

issues.title: CI pipeline is empty stub
issues.explain: CI file is only one line with no jobs to test, build, or check licences. Broken code could ship unchecked.
issues.recommendation: Add full CI jobs for install, build, Docker build, and gated deploy to the office cluster.
issues.ai_prompt: In .github/workflows/ci.yml replace the single 'on: push' line with a full workflow that on push installs, lints, builds, builds the Docker image, and deploys to the office cluster only on main.

issues.title: LICENSE file empty and unclear
issues.explain: LICENSE file is empty while package.json claims UNLICENSED private. Staff and reviewers cannot tell reuse rules.
issues.evidence: LICENSE (0 KB empty) + package.json: private true, license UNLICENSED
issues.recommendation: Add one-line proprietary notice to LICENSE or add a full licence text and keep it matching package.json.
issues.ai_prompt: Create LICENSE file text for proprietary internal use matching package.json UNLICENSED private true, or if open-sourcing replace with MIT text. Keep package.json and LICENSE in sync.

issues.title: No privacy notice for ticket data
issues.explain: Dashboard shows support tickets which usually contain customer names and contact details, plus staff SSO data, with no handling notice.
issues.recommendation: Add internal privacy notice and access rules for ticket data, even if no public policy is needed.
issues.ai_prompt: Add an internal PRIVACY.md explaining what ticket and on-call personal data the ops dashboard shows, who can access it, retention, and Okta logging contact, and link it in README.md.

strengths: Clearly scoped as internal staff-only with Okta SSO described in code and README.
No risky images, fonts, or copy-pasted media found.
Docker plus Kubernetes plus CI intent matches the office-cluster plan.

ms-01b900b0-1d5e-4e98-9b07-6095a44d0b19.headline: Recipe app is not ready to sell: paid fonts, stock photo, music and missing privacy terms block launch.
ms-01b900b0-1d5e-4e98-9b07-6095a44d0b19.summary: Recipe Box is an Expo iPhone/Android app plus Vercel marketing site with $4/month Premium via Stripe. It collects names, emails and birthdays for signups. Paid Gotham font, Shutterstock hero, theme music, Adobe Fonts and missing privacy terms must be fixed before App Store launch.

audience.detail: README says free to start with $4/month Premium, share with friends, App Store and Google Play plus public marketing site.

mobile.detail: package.json uses expo and react-native, app.json sets iOS and Android IDs, eas.json has EAS build config.

deployment.detail: vercel.json and eas.json plus app.json exist for web and mobile, but no CI, empty EAS submit block and no production env setup.

license.detail: No LICENSE file and no declared licence found in checks.

ms-01b900b0-1d5e-4e98-9b07-6095a44d0b19.data_detail: Collects email, name and birthday on signup and takes $4/month Premium subscriptions via Stripe, with no privacy policy or terms found.

issues.title: No privacy policy or terms for paid app
issues.explain: You collect personal data and take payments but have no privacy policy or terms. Stores will reject you and users have no notice.
issues.recommendation: Add Privacy Policy and Terms pages, link them in app and on recipebox.example, and add store privacy URLs.
issues.ai_prompt: In server/index.js and src/App.js the app collects email/name/birthday and Stripe subscriptions but there are no privacy or terms pages. Add Privacy Policy and Terms screens/pages covering data collected, Stripe payments, subscriptions, and contact, link them in web/index.html, in the Expo app settings/about screen, and for App Store Connect privacy URL before submission.

issues.title: Shutterstock hero image needs paid licence
issues.explain: File name shows a Shutterstock image used as the app hero. Without a paid licence this is a takedown risk.
issues.recommendation: Buy the right Shutterstock licence or replace the image and record it in CREDITS.md.
issues.ai_prompt: Check assets/hero-shutterstock_2231987.jpg used in src/App.js line 13. Confirm if a Shutterstock standard or extended licence was purchased for in-app mobile use, replace with a licensed or own image if not, buy the correct licence, and add proof to CREDITS.md.

issues.title: Paid Gotham font bundled without proof
issues.explain: Gotham is a paid font that is bundled in the app. Embedding it needs a purchased licence.
issues.recommendation: Prove the font licence or swap to a free font and remove the .otf.
issues.ai_prompt: Check assets/brand/Gotham-Bold.otf loaded via expo-font in src/App.js line 8. Gotham is a paid commercial font - confirm a mobile app embedding licence was purchased, or replace with an open font like Inter from Google Fonts, remove the .otf if unlicensed, and document in CREDITS.md.

issues.title: Theme music rights unknown plus autoplay
issues.explain: App auto-plays a theme song with no credit. Music needs clear rights for store apps.
issues.recommendation: Prove music rights or replace with royalty-free music and add mute control.
issues.ai_prompt: Check assets/music/theme-song.mp3 auto-played in src/App.js line 9 via expo-av. Identify composer/source, confirm you have sync and mobile-app rights for it, add credit and licence to CREDITS.md, or replace with a royalty-free track and add a mute toggle instead of autoplay.

issues.title: Adobe Fonts kit needs licence check
issues.explain: Marketing site uses a paid Adobe Fonts kit. Wrong kit or domain will break fonts or breach terms.
issues.recommendation: Verify Adobe Fonts kit, allowed domains and active subscription.
issues.ai_prompt: In web/index.html line 2 the site loads https://use.typekit.net/xyz1abc.css (Adobe Fonts). In Adobe Fonts dashboard verify the kit ID, add recipebox.example and Vercel preview domains to allowed domains, confirm the subscription covers this public use, and add fallback fonts if the kit fails.

issues.title: App Store release setup is incomplete
issues.explain: EAS build and submit blocks are minimal with no store metadata. You cannot ship updates reliably yet.
issues.recommendation: Fill out EAS submit config, store privacy URLs, and test builds.
issues.ai_prompt: In eas.json and app.json complete the store release setup: add EAS submit fields for ios bundleIdentifier com.example.recipebox and android package, add versioning, privacyPolicyUrl, and icons/splash confirmation, then test `eas build -p ios`, `eas build -p android` and `eas submit`.

issues.title: Apple Pay logo must follow brand rules
issues.explain: Apple logos have strict display rules. Misuse can cause App Store review issues.
issues.recommendation: Check Apple Pay guidelines and only show logo when Apple Pay works.
issues.ai_prompt: Review assets/icons/apple-pay-logo.png shown in src/App.js line 15 and @stripe/stripe-react-native usage. Follow Apple Pay brand guidelines for logo size/clear space, only show it when Apple Pay is actually available, and remove or replace the image if not using Apple Pay.

issues.title: Production env and backend hosting unclear
issues.explain: Vercel config exists but there is no CI or documented env handling for Stripe keys and backend hosting.
issues.recommendation: Set Stripe keys in Vercel/host env, confirm backend host, and add deploy docs.
issues.ai_prompt: In vercel.json and server/index.js finish production deploy: confirm Vercel outputDirectory web is correct, add separate preview/production env vars for STRIPE_SECRET_KEY and EXPO_PUBLIC_STRIPE_KEY in Vercel dashboard (never commit them), enforce HTTPS, and document deploy steps in README.md.

issues.title: No project licence file
issues.explain: No LICENSE file means no one else may legally reuse the code, and stores and clients often require one.
issues.recommendation: Add a LICENSE file and list open-source credits in CREDITS.md.
issues.ai_prompt: Add a LICENSE file at repo root choosing a licence (e.g. Proprietary - All rights reserved if closed paid app), and check package.json dependencies especially react-native-pdf-lib and Stripe SDKs for copyleft terms. Add third-party notices to CREDITS.md.

issues.title: Confirm Unsplash photo credit
issues.explain: Unsplash images are free but need correct use and credit to avoid disputes.
issues.recommendation: Confirm Unsplash terms, add photographer credit to CREDITS.md.
issues.ai_prompt: In web/index.html line 3 the image uses https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1495521821757-a1efb6729352 directly. Replace hotlink with a downloaded copy with Unsplash credit or keep hotlink per Unsplash API rules, add photographer credit to CREDITS.md, and check food-1.png source the same way.

issues.title: No credits file for images, fonts or sounds
issues.explain: The project ships 7 media files but no CREDITS or NOTICE file says where they came from, so nobody can show you had permission.
issues.recommendation: Add CREDITS.md listing each image, font, icon set and sound with its source and licence.
issues.ai_prompt: Create CREDITS.md at the project root. List every image, icon set, font, sound and video in the project with where it came from and its licence (write 'own work' for ones I made). Ask me about any you cannot tell.

strengths: Secrets use env vars, not hard-coded keys
Deploy intents are clear: Vercel site plus EAS mobile builds
Business model is stated upfront in README

ms-42a5c546-a117-4ac3-bf60-bdd8450245ac.headline: Recipe-sharing app with payments is not ready to ship due to exposed secrets and major security gaps.
ms-42a5c546-a117-4ac3-bf60-bdd8450245ac.summary: Recipe Box is a web app to save, search and share recipes with planned paid premium recipes via Stripe. It has web frontend and Express API with login and Postgres storage for external users. It cannot ship yet with exposed secrets, injection and access flaws, plus missing hosting, privacy pages and licence.

audience.detail: App has sign-up/login and sharing plus paid premium recipes, so it looks built for customers or the public, not staff-only.

mobile.detail: No mobile signals found; code is React web plus Express backend only.

deployment.detail: No deploy config or CI found and frontend calls http://localhost:4000, so it cannot run in production yet.

license.detail: No LICENSE file and no licence declared in package.json was found.

ms-42a5c546-a117-4ac3-bf60-bdd8450245ac.data_detail: Collects emails, passwords and recipes and plans to take payments for premium recipes.

issues.title: Secret keys exposed in frontend
issues.explain: Secret payment and maps keys are written directly in frontend code where anyone can see and reuse them.
issues.recommendation: Remove keys from frontend, use server-side env variables and restrict keys in Stripe/Google dashboards.
issues.ai_prompt: In src/App.jsx remove hardcoded STRIPE_KEY and MAPS_KEY. Load Stripe publishable key from env and move all secret API calls to server/index.js backend. Never put secret keys in frontend code.

issues.title: Database open to injection attacks
issues.explain: Login, search and admin delete build database queries from user input, letting attackers steal or delete data.
issues.evidence: server/index.js: SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = '" + req.body.email + "'"
issues.recommendation: Rewrite all queries with placeholders and add input validation.
issues.ai_prompt: In server/index.js fix all db.query calls to use parameterized queries like $1, $2 instead of string concatenation for email, search and id params.

issues.title: Passwords logged and not protected
issues.explain: Passwords appear to be logged and checked as plain text, so a leak exposes all user passwords.
issues.recommendation: Hash passwords with bcrypt, never log them, and force a password reset.
issues.ai_prompt: In server/index.js stop logging passwords and stop comparing plain-text passwords. Add bcrypt password hashing on signup and bcrypt.compare on login, and remove console.log of credentials.

issues.title: Anyone can delete any user
issues.explain: Anyone on the internet can delete any user with no login check on the admin route.
issues.recommendation: Require login plus admin role for admin routes and test with logged-out request.
issues.ai_prompt: In server/index.js add authentication and admin-role check to DELETE /api/admin/users/:id, use a proper session token stored securely, and validate id as a number.

issues.title: Database password hardcoded in code
issues.explain: Production database password is hardcoded in code and will leak if code is shared.
issues.recommendation: Move DB URL to env secrets manager and rotate the exposed password now.
issues.ai_prompt: In server/index.js replace postgres connection string with process.env.DATABASE_URL, remove hardcoded admin password, and set .env to be git-ignored and never committed.

issues.title: User content can run scripts
issues.explain: Showing recipe text as raw HTML lets an attacker inject scripts that steal other users sessions.
issues.recommendation: Render descriptions as plain text or clean them with a sanitizer library.
issues.ai_prompt: In src/App.jsx stop using dangerouslySetInnerHTML for r.description. Render as text or sanitize with DOMPurify before rendering.

issues.title: Missing privacy policy and terms
issues.explain: External app collects logins and takes payments but has no privacy or terms pages.
issues.recommendation: Add privacy policy and terms, plus Stripe checkout terms and data deletion contact.
issues.ai_prompt: Add a Privacy Policy and Terms page covering accounts, recipes and Stripe payments, link them in src/App.jsx footer, and add them before any public launch or app store listing.

issues.title: No production hosting setup
issues.explain: Server accepts requests from any site and frontend only works on localhost, so production is broken and unsafe.
issues.recommendation: Lock CORS to your domain, use HTTPS API URL from env, and add deploy config.
issues.ai_prompt: In server/index.js change cors({ origin: "*", credentials: true }) to allow only your frontend domain, and in src/App.jsx change fetch http://localhost:4000 to process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL with HTTPS production URL.

issues.title: Server leaks error details
issues.explain: Server sends full error details to users, leaking code and database info to attackers.
issues.recommendation: Send generic error to client and log details only on server.
issues.ai_prompt: In server/index.js change error handler res.status(500).send(err.stack) to log err.stack server-side only and send a generic message like res.status(500).send("Something went wrong").

issues.title: No licence file present
issues.explain: No LICENSE file means no one else may legally use the code and stores/clients often require one.
issues.recommendation: Pick and add a LICENSE file before sharing or selling.
issues.ai_prompt: Add a LICENSE file at project root, e.g. MIT if you want others to reuse it or Proprietary if closed, and update package.json with license field.

strengths: Simple React + Express + Postgres stack is easy to fix and deploy
No third-party media or fonts to license
Very small codebase so security fixes are quick
